notes.title: Achievements Fixed & Mac Version Fixed!
notes.content:
Achievements should be fixed now! Sorry it was delayed. Any achievements you should have obtained should be automatically granted next time you play. If it's not the case, please let us know and any details about what's wrong. :)

BTW Mac users, if any of you had issues on the first few hours of release, I'm very sorry! We had a mistake for the Mac version that's was also rectified, so it should work now.

A few typos that were reported were also fixed.

Let us know if there are any other concerns. Thank you so much!
-aMira
